1 Executive Summary & Value Proposition

SSJ INVOICE™ is an autonomous, multi-tenant Cloud SaaS platform designed to automate end-to-end commercial billing, statutory GST tax compliance, zero-gateway-fee NPCI UPI digital payments, and real-time customer financial ledgers for modern Indian businesses and enterprises.

Key Differentiator: Zero-MDR Dynamic UPI Payment Rails

Traditional ERP platforms require commercial payment gateway integrations that deduct 2% to 3% in Merchant Discount Rates (MDR). SSJ INVOICE embeds an autonomous Dynamic NPCI UPI QR Code Engine directly into printed and digital invoices. Customers scan with Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, or BHIM, settling funds directly into the merchant's bank account with ₹0 transaction fees and instantaneous settlement.

3 Domain Terminology & Statutory Accounting Concepts

Multi-Tenancy

Logical database partitioning where multiple business accounts share a single software instance while remaining strictly isolated via business_id foreign key constraints.

GSTIN & State Matching

15-character statutory tax ID (e.g. 27AAPCU9603R1ZV). The first 2 characters denote State Code (27 = Maharashtra), which determines automatic tax categorization.

Intra-State (CGST + SGST)

Transactions where Supplier State == Customer State. Automatically splits the tax into 50% Central GST and 50% State GST (e.g., 18% = 9% CGST + 9% SGST).

Inter-State (IGST)

Transactions across state boundaries (Supplier State != Customer State). Charged as a single 100% Integrated GST line item.

HSN & SAC Codes

Standard classification codes: HSN for physical goods, SAC for services. Maintained in the product catalog and printed on all GST tax documents.

Delivery Challan (GST Rule 55)

Statutory transport document used for the dispatch of goods for job work, supply on approval, or transit before final tax invoicing.

Credit Note

Accounting document issued against an invoice to reduce receivable balance for customer returns, discounts, or rate revisions.

Customer Running Ledger

Continuous balance audit trail dynamically calculated as: Total Invoiced - Payments Received - Credit Notes = Net Balance Due.

4 Core Functional Modules & Features

1. Multi-Tenant Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
Granular permissions for SUPER_ADMIN (platform management), BUSINESS_ADMIN (business owner), ACCOUNTANT (tax & reports), and STAFF (sales).
2. SaaS Subscription Management & Quota Enforcement
Tiered subscription plans (Free: ₹0/mo max 10 invoices, Pro: ₹499/mo unlimited + dynamic QR, Enterprise: ₹4,999/yr multi-user). Automated expiration checks and monthly quota locks.
3. Dynamic Invoicing & Billing Lifecycle
Full lifecycle tracking: DRAFT → SENT → PARTIAL → PAID → CANCELLED. Interactive row addition, instant tax calculation, and balance recalculation.
4. Zero-Cost Dynamic NPCI UPI QR Generator
Embedded vector QR codes containing merchant VPA and exact invoice amount. Generates dynamic UPI deep-links enabling 0% MDR direct-to-bank settlements.
5. Estimates / Quotations with 1-Click Conversion
Create professional quotations with validity dates. 1-click conversion generates an official tax invoice without re-entering line items.
6. Delivery Challans & Credit Notes
Statutory goods transit slips under GST Rule 55 and formal credit note adjustments linked directly to invoices.
7. Masters Catalog (Items & Customers)
Central catalog for products/services with HSN/SAC codes, stock tracking, and default tax rates. Client address book with state-code tracking.
8. Customer Ledgers & Multi-Mode Payments
Record payments across UPI, Bank Transfer (NEFT/RTGS), Cash, Cheque, and Card. Real-time running balance ledger.
9. Statutory GST Reports (GSTR-1 & GSTR-3B)
Automated tax reports providing B2B/B2C sales breakdown, taxable turnover, and CGST/SGST/IGST tax liability matrices for tax accountants.
10. Professional Print & PDF Engine
Clean, tax-compliant invoice printing with merchant branding, bank details, terms & conditions, and dynamic scannable QR code.
